summary: DescriptorProfile is a MountainAshBaseSettings subclass that auto-generates pydantic fields from a __descriptor__ (ProfileDescriptor) at class-creation time via __pydantic_init_subclass__. It also assembles a discriminated auth union field. Provides _default_kwargs() for 1:1 driver-key mappings and _auth_kwargs() for auth dispatch.
extension_points: __adapter__ class variable — if set, takes over the full output pipeline (replaces _default_kwargs + _auth_kwargs)
_auth_kwargs() — override in domain subclasses to customise auth-to-driver mapping
post_init() — inherits template auto-wiring; extend in domain subclasses
lifecycle_notes: __pydantic_init_subclass__ fires at class-creation time — fields are materialised before any instance is created
Intermediate subclasses (no __descriptor__ in their own __dict__) are skipped
model_rebuild(force=True) is called after field installation — necessary for pydantic v2 to register dynamic annotations
documentation_hooks: Domain adapters declare __descriptor__ = MY_DESCRIPTOR and optionally __adapter__ = my_adapter_fn
auth field is a discriminated union keyed on 'kind' literal — one pydantic model per auth mode
risks: Dynamic field installation via model_fields mutation and model_rebuild() is not officially documented in pydantic v2 — may need adjustment on pydantic upgrades
